verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own docs state WHOIS privacy is free and hides name, email, and phone from public WHOIS, explicitly framed as a default security feature bundled with registration/transfer (not an upsell) — e.g. 'free domain privacy' offered alongside account lock and 2FA, and 'free privacy' included when transferring domains in. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that privacy is toggled ON by default at signup (vs. opt-in) and independent/hands-on user corroboration beyond vendor docs.
